description: A SessionStart(compact) hook that nudges a compacted lead to run lead-revive before anything else, and the Claude mod (claude-mod/register.ts), the one hooks module Claude Code accepts per plugin. Its mailbox push feature: once the agent binds its session key through the mod's mailbox watch tool, arriving cross-session mail starts a turn even in an idle session. Its lead compaction timing feature (ws only): advisory and milestone wake turns before native auto compaction, and a compaction request tool the lead calls at a boundary of its choosing. Claude Code auto-discovers this file by its hooks/hooks.json path; there is no plugin.json pointer to it (contrast the Codex adapter, whose manifest names its hooks file explicitly).
